target_audience: Premium property owners, corporate facilities, residential communities

headings.usage: Use for all main section titles and the hero text for an elegant, warm, organic feel. Apply tracking-tighter for sizes above 32px.

body.usage: Clean, legible, and slightly warm geometric sans for all body copy, forms, and functional text.

accent.usage: For overlines and small labels, uppercase with wide letter spacing (tracking-widest).

logo.description: Original logo design for ZeniTeco: A modern, minimalist 'Z' where one of the diagonal strokes extends and curves organically into a subtle leaf shape. Provide the inline SVG directly in the codebase (JSX) and use it for the header and favicon.

hero.behavior: Kinetic line-by-line text reveal on load. The hero image should have a slow zoom/parallax effect (using framer-motion/lenis) as the user scrolls down.
hero.overlay: bg-black/40 overlay to ensure H1 text contrast.

items.title: Administración de inmuebles
items.description: Dominant visual block highlighting property management.

items.title: Servicios combinados de apoyo
items.description: Bottom right block for facility support.

marquee.style: Slow editorial ribbon. Very slow, smooth drift. Pale text with high spacing.

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' for the sticky header: backdrop-blur-xl, subtle border-white/10, bg-[#12261A]/70.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a very subtle noise/grain CSS/SVG overlay across the entire site to give it an organic, premium feel.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #1E3B2A to separate bento grid items and cards without using heavy drop shadows.

motion.scrolling: Use 'lenis' (or similar smooth scroll provider) for smooth momentum scrolling.
motion.animations: Framer Motion for layout reveals. Staggered fade-up for bento grid. On-load signature moment: SVG trace animation for the logo 'Z', followed by kinetic H1 text mask reveal.
motion.hover_states: Interactive elements should have slight lifts (-translate-y-1) and change border/text color to the accent (#D8F33C).
motion.marquee_speed: Very slow drift to emphasize luxury.

components.header: Fixed, sticky with glassmorphism. Desktop links visible (do not hide in a burger menu on desktop), logo on left, contact CTA on right.
components.forms: Use Shadcn UI forms heavily customized for .js. Dark inputs with 1px border (#1E3B2A), focus ring in the accent color (#D8F33C), dark backgrounds. Labels in light cream.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-none (sharp) buttons. Primary CTA should have the neon-lime accent background (#D8F33C) with dark text (#08140D) for extreme contrast and high conversion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the light cream text meets WCAG AA on the dark botanical background. Hero image MUST have bg-black/40 overlay. No transparent backgrounds behind text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the marquee and scroll animations.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an Awwwards-level landing page. DO NOT default to a basic Vercel or generic Tailwind template. This is high-end design.
Implement the custom SVG logo: a 'Z' blending into a leaf.
Do NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Use Playfair Display (headings) and Manrope (body). Provide Google Font imports in index.css.
Use framer-motion for the kinetic masked text reveal in the hero section.
Construct the Services section using the Tetris Bento grid exactly as described.
Include realistic Spanish (es) content. Do not use generic Lorem Ipsum. Use names like 'Mateo Vargas', 'Camila Rojas'. H1 should be something like 'Gestión experta para entornos que inspiran'.
Create a Contact form section at the bottom (Nombre, Email, Teléfono, Servicio, Mensaje).
Apply the styling exclusively in standard .js/.jsx React files (NOT .tsx). Customize Shadcn components in JS.
Add 'data-testid' to every interactive button, input, and link.
CRITICAL: Header must have a solid or highly opaque blurred background. Never leave it fully transparent when scrolling over content.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add specific transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/sonner.jsx or similar path.
